race.comment: CENTIMETRE (8) three-year-old colt by Extreme Choice colt out of Warmth on debut for the O'Shea & Charlton camp.  At the most recent trial he finished fourth over 1045m at Randwick August 28. Can lift under race conditions in a winnable contest. OUTSTRIDER (10) three-year-old gelding by Pariah from Perissa on debut for the Waterhouse & Bott yard. Has been thereabouts in his last two trials and kicks off in the right race. Will roll forward and take catching. COSMIC ECHO (3) defied the betting drift on debut with a respectable third from back in the field over 900m at Newcastle. Ready for this trip and should be able to race closer today. Each-way player. SEQUOIA (13) three-year-old Stay Inside filly out of California Gallant on debut for the Michael Freedman yard. Has trialled okay and worth thought.
